svg.title: Acrylic for Hermes Agent - Three panes, one bonsai
svg.desc: The official Hermes girl peeks over an oversized fan of four acrylic leaves, each showing one preset: Acrylic (#E5EFE6, lightest), Frosted (#ADC5BB, deeper and blurrier), Sanded (#CCB99A, fine grain), Expressive (#9F5E56, deepest and most colourful). Sunset garden palette: #B5503F #E8825C #F6B57E #FCDCA6 #2F6B5C #244D46.
